title: VERIFY T-476: the parallel runner never reports a pass that serial pytest would fail
acceptance_criteria: Replay serial and parallel on the same tree: counts must match. In throwaway copies: plant a failing test in the last shard; plant an import error in one test file; make one shard hang past a timeout. Each must make fast_tests exit nonzero and name the cause.

Run fast_tests 3 times in a row while another process edits an unrelated file under .harness/tests in a throwaway copy, and report what happens. Confirm standard library only and that the durations file is untracked. Verdict.
